headline: How the National Bank's Decision Will Allow Businesses to Develop Despite Intensified Russian Armed Forces Attacks: NBU Governor Andriy Pyshnyi Explains
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine continues measures to preserve access to financing for companies in strategically important sectors, Governor Andriy Pyshnyi reported, amid Russian attacks.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine sets monetary policy and oversees the banking system, shaping credit conditions for Ukrainian companies.
